newsitem.title: USA: Moler to be U.S. deputy energy secretary - Murkowski.
newsitem.headline: Moler to be U.S. deputy energy secretary - Murkowski.

text.p: U.S. Senate Energy Committee Chairman Frank Murkowski said Tuesday he expected his committee will vote overwhelmingly in favor of Elizabeth Moler to be deputy energy secretary.

"Betsy Moler will be the nation's next deputy secretary of energy," Murkowski, an Alaska Republican, said in a statement. "Members of this committee will vote overwhelmingly in her favor Wednesday morning."
Murkowski said Wednesday's scheduled committee vote for Moler, who currently serves as chairman of the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission, may be unanimous.
Moler still must be confirmed by the full Senate, which generally follows the lead of the committee of jurisdiction.
Murkowski said he did not yet know when the Senate floor vote would be scheduled.
Moler was the Clinton administration's choice to replace Charles Curtis, who announced he planned to resign from the position.
